verdict.rationale: Granola's docs describe speaker tags that show each participant's name above their parts of the conversation, going beyond the default "Me" and "Them" labels. That is named-speaker attribution rather than generic Speaker 1/2. It rests on a single doc line, and the default being only Me/Them suggests the feature may be opt-in or limited. Missing for 10: detail on how diarization and name matching work (e.g., calendar attendee mapping, in-person or mobile support, manual correction), evidence of attribution accuracy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
